latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Of Video — Edit and Export Video Clips".
- Upload phone videos and request edits or exports via simple text instructions.
- Automatic cloud connection and authentication (100 free credits, 7-day expiry per token).
- Supports trimming, background music, aspect ratio, text overlays, and more, with output up to 1080p.
- Handles common errors (invalid token, file too large, insufficient credits) with user-friendly messages.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline: average export time 30-90 seconds per clip.
